Inside a Luxury Custom Built Home in Temple TX | Dream Features You Won't Believe!

FREE GUIDE:
Home Buyer Guide (New Construction) → https://bit.ly/4gaw6TI

Discover the beauty of a truly custom home in Temple, TX! Located in the sought-after community of Valor Estates, this stunning semi-custom new construction is a perfect blend of luxury and functionality. My clients are moving in just 3 days, and they couldn’t be more excited! This video showcases how everything came together to create their dream home!

Key Features:
✔️ A luxury kitchen with quartz countertops, black accents, and a spacious layout
✔️ Flowing design connecting the kitchen, living, and dining areas
✔️ Unique touches, including a custom dog shower for their golden retriever 
✔️ Gorgeous design details, like blue accents and picture windows 

If you’re thinking about buying, building, or simply looking for inspiration, this tour is for you! Don’t forget to like, subscribe, and hit the bell icon for more tours of luxury homes and real estate insights in Central Texas!
